turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My new flat is on the tenth floor and the balcony is so windy. I need plants that cope.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll tell you all the choices first. Wait until I'm finished before you comment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I was looking at ornamental grasses, they sway around and apparently don't snap.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Lavender is another idea, because it's tough and smells nice when you brush past.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or succulents in heavy pots, since they hold onto water and stay low.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Alright, I'm finished. What's your opinion?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Grasses are made for wind, they bend instead of breaking and look lovely moving. Lavender is tough too and handles dry, breezy spots well. Succulents are fine as long as the pots are heavy, but some get scorched in that much wind and sun.
